title: Package Handoff Artifacts
description: Collects diagnostic scratch artifacts, sanitizes HLO dumps, and uploads them into canonical handoff paths (upload is on by default). Artifacts with no source are listed in missing_artifacts instead of being written as placeholder files; exits non-zero on any upload failure.
instruction: python3 tools/scripts/handoff/package_handoff_artifacts.py --findings=${findings} $([ -n "${bucket}" ] && echo "--bucket=${bucket}") $([ -n "${workload}" ] && echo "--workload=${workload}") $([ -n "${triage_json}" ] && echo "--triage_json=${triage_json}") $([ -n "${staging_dir}" ] && echo "--staging_dir=${staging_dir}") $([ "${upload}" = "false" -o "${upload}" = "False" ] && echo "--no_upload")

workload.description: Target workload name (used for scratch triage discovery)

triage_json.description: Path to /troubleshoot triage state JSON file

upload.description: Upload staged artifacts to GCS (default true; false stages locally only)
